sentences.en: Despite the importance of sleep, its purpose is a mystery.
sentences.zh: 尽管睡眠很重要，但它的目的仍然是个谜。

sentences.en: Look at the cute little baby sleeping in the cradle.
sentences.zh: 看看摇篮里那个可爱的小宝宝正在睡觉。

sentences.en: Last night I did not get a wink of sleep.
sentences.zh: 昨晚我一点觉也没睡着。

senses.zh: 为…提供床位；提供住宿；以睡觉打发日子
